dim0.description: the first dimension to be transposed
constraints: dim0 and dim1 must be valid dimensions in the shape of input
if input is sparse, dim0 and dim1 must both be batch or sparse dimensions

dim1.description: the second dimension to be transposed
constraints: dim0 and dim1 must be valid dimensions in the shape of input
if input is sparse, dim0 and dim1 must both be batch or sparse dimensions

output.description: a tensor that is a transposed version of input

constraints: dim0 and dim1 must be valid dimensions in the shape of input
if input is sparse, dim0 and dim1 must both be batch or sparse dimensions
